paper.title: Online Service Provisioning in NFV-Enabled Networks Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
paper.venue: IEEE Transactions on Network and Service Management 19(3), 3276-3289

blocks.original_text: DRL framework for online NFV service provisioning under QoS and limited resources.
blocks.translation: 面向 QoS 与有限资源约束的在线 NFV 服务供给 DRL 框架。

blocks.original_text: DQN-AR jointly performs function placement and dynamic routing.
blocks.translation: DQN-AR 联合执行功能放置和动态路由。

blocks.original_text: Reported admission and utilization-cost improvements.
blocks.translation: 论文报告的接受率和资源成本改进。

blocks.original_text: Motivation: heterogeneous probabilistic-lifetime services over shared resources.
blocks.translation: 共享资源上的异构随机生命周期服务。

blocks.original_text: Admission, arrival, departure and resource release semantics.
blocks.translation: 接纳、到达、离开和资源释放语义。

blocks.original_text: Research contributions and baselines.
blocks.translation: 研究贡献与对比基线。

blocks.original_text: Service specification and requirements.
blocks.translation: 服务规格与需求。

blocks.original_text: Successive and non-successive SFC placement.
blocks.translation: 连续与非连续 SFC 放置。

blocks.original_text: Physical-node, VM, link and path model.
blocks.translation: 物理节点、VM、链路和路径模型。

blocks.original_text: Processing, propagation and transmission delay.
blocks.translation: 处理、传播与传输时延。

blocks.original_text: Weighted resource-cost objective and hard constraints.
blocks.translation: 加权资源成本目标与硬约束。

blocks.original_text: Integer linear optimization motivates RL.
blocks.translation: 整数线性优化问题促使作者采用 RL。

blocks.original_text: SDN controller as RL agent.
blocks.translation: SDN 控制器作为 RL 智能体。

blocks.original_text: DQN hyperparameters and replay.
blocks.translation: DQN 超参数与经验回放。

blocks.original_text: Resource state matrices Z and Y.
blocks.translation: 资源状态矩阵 Z 和 Y。

blocks.original_text: Service features and maximum 100 decisions.
blocks.translation: 服务特征与最多 100 次决策。

blocks.original_text: Resource allocation and lifecycle release.
blocks.translation: 资源分配与生命周期释放。

blocks.original_text: Node-VM placement/forwarding action space.
blocks.translation: 节点-VM 放置/转发动作空间。

blocks.original_text: Piecewise acceptance-cost reward.
blocks.translation: 接纳-成本分段奖励。

blocks.original_text: Incremental routing and placement algorithm.
blocks.translation: 增量路由与放置算法。

blocks.original_text: Computational complexity.
blocks.translation: 计算复杂度。

blocks.original_text: Simulation topology, capacity and QoS ranges.
blocks.translation: 仿真拓扑、容量与 QoS 参数范围。

blocks.original_text: Time slots, iterations, Monte Carlo runs and stochastic traffic.
blocks.translation: 时隙、训练迭代、蒙特卡洛重复和随机流量。

blocks.original_text: AAR convergence.
blocks.translation: AAR 收敛结果。

blocks.original_text: ANUC convergence.
blocks.translation: ANUC 收敛结果。

blocks.original_text: Arrival rate versus utilization cost.
blocks.translation: 到达率与资源成本。

blocks.original_text: Reward-weight trade-off.
blocks.translation: 奖励权重的接受率-成本权衡。

blocks.original_text: Service lifetime effect.
blocks.translation: 服务生命周期影响。

blocks.original_text: Network-resource and topology effect.
blocks.translation: 网络资源与拓扑影响。

blocks.original_text: Future RL methods.
blocks.translation: 未来强化学习方向。

blocks.original_text: Conclusion.
blocks.translation: 结论。

blocks.translation: 所考虑系统模型的高层表示。

blocks.translation: SFC 不同功能放置场景示例。

blocks.translation: 传播和传输时延计算示意。

blocks.translation: 功能放置和逐节点路由示例。

blocks.translation: DQN 根据网络状态和服务规格确定动作。

blocks.translation: 不同网络拓扑下 AAR 随迭代变化。

blocks.translation: 不同网络拓扑下 ANUC 随迭代变化。
